# Snapshot

A snapshot (`ConversationSnapshot`) is the frozen conversation under explanation: an ordered tuple of Turn (`knowledge/architecture/domain.md`) objects plus a `snapshot_id`. `from_turns` derives the id from a SHA-256 over every Message (`knowledge/concepts/Message.md`) (role and text for text-only messages, every part otherwise), so rendering a coalition produces a new snapshot with a new id. `from_json` and `to_json` read and write the text form the command line uses.

Package: domain (`knowledge/architecture/domain.md`).

Source: `knowledge/concepts/Snapshot.md`.
